title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Agentic Causal Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.22846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out. Whether they do more than that, such as noticing where an algorithm went wrong and fixing it with further tests, is hard to tell from current benchmarks. Most of them give the variables meaningful names, and an LLM shown only the names of the T\"ubingen cause-effect pairs already gets 99% of the directions right. With the names removed, the data are usually clean enough that picking a better algorithm than PC closes most of the gap. We introduce Heuresis, a benchmark of anonymous simulated datasets whose mechanisms range from linear Gaussian to heavy-tailed. For each family of datasets it separates what a better existing algorithm can gain from what only a closer look at the data can gain, and it traces every edge an agent changes. translated_title: 基准测试与增强智能体式因果发现
translated_abstract: LLM智能体现在可以在数据集上运行因果发现算法并报告其结果，但它们是否做得更多——例如发现算法在何处出错并通过进一步的检验加以修正——从现有基准测试中很难判断。大多数基准测试为变量赋予了有意义的名称，而一个仅看到图宾根（Tübingen）因果对变量名称的LLM，就已经能在99%的情况下正确判断因果方向。在去除名称后，数据通常足够“干净”，以至于仅选择一个比PC更好的算法就能弥补大部分差距。我们提出了Heuresis，这是一个由匿名模拟数据集构成的基准测试，其数据生成机制涵盖从线性高斯分布到厚尾分布。对于每一族数据集，它将“更好的现有算法所能带来的提升”与“只有更仔细地审视数据才能带来的提升”区分开来，并追踪智能体所修改的每一条边。每一族数据集都留下了一个缺口，无论是算法、路由器还是我们测试的两个因果发现基础模型都无法填补（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出Heuresis基准，通过匿名模拟数据集评估LLM智能体的因果发现能力，区分出现有算法的收益上限与需要智能体深入检查数据才能弥补的差距，从而推动智能体式因果发现的增强。
en_tdlr: We introduce Heuresis, a benchmark of anonymous simulated datasets that separates what better existing causal discovery algorithms can achieve from what only a closer look at the data can gain, thereby benchmarking and enhancing agentic causal discovery.
